description: Final class representing data for group loan individual monitoring accounts within the Fineract project. It contains fields such as loan IDs, account numbers, principal amounts, account counts, and loan status, with factory methods for instantiation.

classes.name: GroupLoanIndividualMonitoringAccountData
classes.description: Immutable data object for monitoring account details related to group loans, with getter methods and static factory methods.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance with detailed data including account IDs, amounts, and status.

methods.name: getInstance1
methods.description: Creates a new instance with limited data, mainly for cases with parent principal amount and account ID.

methods.name: getGlimId
methods.description: Returns the GLIM ID associated with the account.

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Returns the group ID associated with the account.

methods.name: getChildAccountNumber
methods.description: Returns the child account number if available.

methods.name: getChildAccountsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of child accounts.

methods.name: getLoanStatus
methods.description: Returns the status of the loan.
